name: sparkjoy
description: Compacts Claude Code's conversation when a piece of work is finished, rather than when the context fills: after each turn, and before an idle session's prompt cache lapses, the session's own model decides.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: on asks the session's model whether to compact at turn ends and in idle sessions, and compacts when it says to; classify asks and shows each verdict but never compacts; off asks nothing.

floor.title: Floor at turn ends
floor.description: The context, in tokens, from which sparkjoy asks at a turn end: above the context a compaction leaves and below 1000000. Unset, it is the floor /sparkjoy report fitted, or 250000.

idle_floor.title: Floor in idle sessions
idle_floor.description: The context, in tokens, from which sparkjoy asks before an idle session's prompt cache lapses: below 1000000. Unset, it is the floor /sparkjoy report fitted, or 175000.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: Your own guidance for the decision, added to sparkjoy's question.
